email.subject: Application Follow-up: Cape
email.body:
Hi Candidate, 

Thank you for taking the time to apply with us for the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) role at Cape. After careful consideration, we've determined that there isn't a fit at this time, and we will not be moving forward with your candidacy. 

We appreciate your interest in Cape and would love to keep in touch as the needs of our business evolve. 

Cheers,

Cape
